## Agent test runner
1. **Run Agent** must point to **04_Validation_Fraud_Decision_Agent**.
2. Click **Execute workflow**. Tests run one by one with a short pause so the free AI isn't overloaded.
3. Open **Check Results**, Table view. The first row says ALL PASSED or how many failed; each row explains its problem.

**Seed Test Photo** puts test photo A in the *photo hashes* Data Table under the old claim CLM-H001, so V12 can check that a reused photo is caught.
Re-run after every change to your agent.
